issue.title: ace-prompts.md config reference still calls the prompt composer the "prompt input widget" / "prompt bar"

task_type_fields.impact: Readers of the ace.snippets, ace.snippet_config_path, word-completion, and misspelling-highlight config reference see the retired widget names, inconsistent with the TUI, the rest of the docs, and the Prompt Composer glossary term. Docs-only; no runtime impact.
task_type_fields.repro:
Commit 1da3a8e154 ("feat(tui): rename prompt input to prompt composer") renamed the widget across the docs, but in the hand-written behavior page `docs/reference/config/ace-prompts.md` it changed only the snippets.md link text. The page's prose still uses the retired names:

- `ace.snippet_config_path`: "entries written from the prompt bar"
- `ace.snippets`: "Defines expandable text snippets for the prompt input widget", "Press `Tab` in the prompt input", "In sase's TUI prompt input, `Tab` advances..."
- word-completion section: "word completion in sase's TUI prompt input. Suggestions appear in the prompt-bar subtitle"
- misspelling-highlight section: "sticky misspelling highlight in sase's TUI prompt input", "underlined in every prompt input from then on"
- one more "...agent prompts from sase's TUI prompt input." near the end of the page

Reproduce:

    git grep -n -i -E "prompt[ -]bar\b|prompt input widget|TUI prompt input" -- docs ':!docs/blog' ':!docs/_meta' ':!docs/reference/glossary.md'

`docs/reference/config/ace-prompts.md` is the only page with real prose hits. The `docs/ace.md` matches are legacy-anchor stubs (link text such as "Prompt input widget" / "Authoring a snippet from the prompt bar" next to preserved `<a id>` anchors); check whether those stubs are generated from `docs/_meta/splits` before deciding whether their link text should change. The `ace.prompt_inputs` feature ("Prompt Inputs") is unrelated and must not be renamed.

issue.creation_reason: Found while planning the chezmoi piw snippet update: the prompt-composer rename (1da3a8e154) skipped the prose in the hand-written ACE prompt config page, so the config reference contradicts the new glossary term.
